content: Ughanja na nnima
Mikoha yinguhuma kwoki, na matutano nkati yenu ghanguhuma kwoki? Ghanguhuma mu tama yenu hakata yiitutana ngondo mu nkati yenu?

Mungupala kubhegha na hilibhi na kiyaha munguhimokola ng'obhe ndo mungukoma bhandu, mungupala muno kubhegha na hilibhi, peni kuhimokola ng'obhe, habhu mungulimbana na kututana. Mungumokola ng'obhe hila himuhipala kiyaha mungunnyupa ng'obhe Chapanga.
Kangi pannyupa munguhimokola ng'obhe kiyaha munguyupa kwa ningo hakataho, ili mmokole kuhitumila ahyo hinpala kumokola kwa tama hyenu hakataho.

Mwenga mangahyubhalika handa atyahe, Bhuli mungumanya ng'obhe kukita kupalwa na nnima ndo umyanja na Chapanga? Kya habhu, ywohele ywakapala kubhegha nng'anja ghwa nnima kangutendeka nmyanja ghwa Chapanga.
Nkotoke kuhwacha kukita malembo gha Chapanga ghangulongela malagho gha yaghi, paghalongela, “Aghwo Nhuki, ywakabhikitwe na Chapanga nkati yetu kabhegha na malili makulu”
Peni ywombe kangutupegha twenga umaha kyanalumu. Habhu ndo mana malembo gha Chapanga ghangulongela, “Chapanga kanguapingika bhaabheghite na ngangatala peni kanguapegha nonelo bhanakuhwama.”
Hinu munnyitikile Chapanga. Munpingikihe Nchipila naywo kataatugha.

Munheghelele Chapanga, naywo kataaheghelela mwenga. Mwenga mummeghite na ulemwa mughuleke ulemwa ghwenu ntende gha maha! Na muyitendekehe myoyo yenu yibheghe ya nyani mwenga mummeghite na ningo mbili!
Myoyo yinu yibhabhine, nlile na kukulika, kuheka kwa mwenga na kubheghe kililo, na kuyeylela kwa mwenga kubheghe ngukuliko ngulu.
Nhwame muulongolo ghwa Chapanga, naywo kataayinula.
Lukinyo kwakya kuatosa bhangi

Maalongo, nkotoke kughomelana mahakata mabhene, ywakanng'ombela uhakata nnongo ghwake na kuntosa, kangulongela uhakata kwakya malaghilo na kulongela malaghilo ghangunoghwa ng'obhe. Paghulongela malaghilo ghangunoghwa ng'obhe, ghwenga ghungughayitikila ng'obhe ngati ghungughalema.
Chapanga ghweka chake ndo ywakaghabhikite malaghilo na toso. Ywombe ghweka chake ndo ywakahotola kulopoha na kukanjaghana. Hinu ghwenga ndo ghani mbaka ghunguntasa mundu nnyako?
Lukinyo kwakya kulikweha
Basi, mwenga nnyihwe na munakulongela, “Lelo ebu kilabho twaaghenda mu kitami kimu na kutama akwo ngungwa yoha twaachuusa na kumokola ngalabha ngenju.”
Mwenga mungumanja ng'obhe hata kiipala kubwituka kilabho! Mwenga ndo handa unguungweta ghuubwituka kya mandina na kubhuka.
Yinguanogha kulongela, “Handa pakapala Chapanga, twaatama na kutenda aki na kila”
Peni hinu mungulitika na kulighamba, kulighamba kwakya luhumu alu ndo uhakata.
Basi mundu ywakamanya kughatenda gha maha, peni kangutenda ng'obhe ghama, mundu aywo kangutenda ulemwa.
